Vendored, unmodified, so the native Windows app builds with no network access:
  go-webview2   https://github.com/jchv/go-webview2   (MIT)   - hosts Microsoft WebView2 in a Win32 window
  go-winloader  https://github.com/jchv/go-winloader  (MIT)   - loads the embedded WebView2Loader.dll from memory
  x-sys         https://go.googlesource.com/sys @ v0.20.0 (BSD) - only the "windows" package
